day_shape: 78 items: Trump says he paused a planned Tuesday strike on Iran after Gulf states intervened, UK Foreign Secretary urges reopening of Strait of Hormuz, CENTCOM reports 85 vessels redirected under US blockade, IDF kills PIJ Beqaa commander.

threads.label: Trump pauses planned Iran strike
threads.summary: Trump said on Truth Social he held off a strike planned for Tuesday after Gulf leaders, including the UAE, asked for more time for talks. Iran said it had responded to an 'excessive' US proposal, while Pezeshkian said Iran would not 'surrender' in dialogue with Washington.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US blockade
threads.summary: UK Foreign Secretary warned the world cannot wait longer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, citing looming food-security risks; CENTCOM said US forces have redirected 85 commercial vessels and disabled 4 enforcing the blockade. Iran announced a new Persian Gulf Strait Authority to assert control, while Tanker Trackers reported a sanctioned LPG tanker loaded at Kharg Island undetected.

threads.label: IDF Lebanon strikes and evacuations
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Wael Mahmoud Abd al-Halim, Islamic Jihad's Beqaa commander, in a Baalbek strike, and intercepted Hezbollah rockets and drones near Kiryat Shmona. IDF Arabic spokesperson issued evacuation warnings for al-Ma'shouk, Burj al-Shimali, Harouf and Dibel; Times of Israel reported Lebanon's death toll has passed 3,000.

threads.label: Iran extraterritorial operations and detentions
threads.summary: UK prosecutors told a London court that Romanian men who stabbed Iran International presenter Pouria Zeraati in 2024 acted as proxies for Tehran; Europol said 14,200 IRGC-linked posts were targeted in a coordinated takedown. Iran's police chief Radan claimed 6,500 espionage-related arrests since the war began, while US resident Shahab Dalili returned home after a decade in Iranian detention.

threads.label: Iran wartime economy and leadership messaging
threads.summary: Pezeshkian told Iranians to accept inflation, fuel shortages and war damage, defending US talks against hardliners, while parliament's vice speaker blamed price rises partly on weak supervision. Khamenei's office posted that studies have been done on 'opening other fronts' where the enemy is vulnerable, and called for safeguarding civilisational independence.

threads.label: Humanitarian and human-rights reports
threads.summary: UNHCR reported shifting protection concerns for Afghan refugees in Iran since the 7–8 April ceasefire, and UN OCHA's situation report cited damage to more than 149,000 civilian structures inside Iran in the tenth week of escalation. Amnesty International said Iran drove a global surge in executions in 2025 to a four-decade high.

threads.label: Regional alignments and Hamas succession
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Pakistan is sending fighter jets and thousands of troops to Saudi Arabia to help counter Iran, and the State Department issued its determination of countries not cooperating fully with antiterrorism efforts. Hamas was reported to have named Mohammed Odeh/Ouda as new commander of the Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades following the killing of Izz ad-Din al-Haddad.
